chunks: And We bestowed on him Isaac, and Jacob as an additional gift, and made them righteous.

key_terms.نَافِلَةً: An additional gift or supererogatory bestowal

ai.seo_question: Who were the sons bestowed upon Prophet Ibrahim as an additional gift in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'nafila' (additional gift) is often interpreted to signify that Isaac and Jacob were granted prophethood as a special, extra honor beyond the general righteousness of their father, Ibrahim. This verse establishes the sanctity of the Ahl al-Bayt lineage, linking the purity of the Prophets to the continuous chain of Imams who inherit this spiritual legacy. It reinforces the concept that divine guidance and righteousness are preserved within a specific, blessed lineage chosen by Allah.
